name: Yandex Images reverse image search
tier_rationale: Established company with published terms (A8; P260 cond 5: 'trusted - ... Yandex (RU jurisdiction)'). Russian operator: the link carries max_tlp green and the notice 'foreign provider (RU): the URL goes to a Russian operator' (P260 cond 10).

reliability.justification: Manual reverse-image or map pages whose content is third-party or user-generated: reliability cannot be judged at provider level (manual links only).

images_url.title: Yandex Images search?rpt=imageview&url= (manual reverse-image links)

terms.quote: The pack is offline data (disclosure 'none'): V3LUM never requests these URLs or any API behind them.

images_url.notes: Research C0610 terms 'Yandex ToS' (yandex.com/images/search?rpt=imageview&url={urlencoded_image_url}; 200 with CBIR results, 2.9 s, no CAPTCHA from the research egress 2026-11-26; CAPTCHA on bursts). Yandex fetches the image server-side (flags.fetches_target). Listed only by `v3lum links` at TLP:AMBER and above (x_max_tlp green). Used by pivots_geo_image.

notes: Seeded by batch p2-G12-1 (P260). Manual links only: V3LUM never requests yandex.com.
